effectiveDate.note: Legal effectiveness is tied to the exchange of ratifications explicitly recorded in the official 1792 treaty printing.

geometry.derivationNote: Article III source-verifies the Dniester as the interstate boundary, with lands on its left/east bank remaining in Russian possession and lands on its right/west bank returned to the Ottoman Porte. Exact line geometry requires the contemporaneous 1792 river course and period official cartography; Bessarabia west/right of the Dniester must not be included in this change.

territoryChanges.notes: The legal boundary rule is verified; geometry awaits historical hydrography rather than a modern river substitute.

geometry.derivationNote: The treaty source-verifies Ottoman confirmation of the earlier Russian possession/status of Crimea and Kuban. This is a recognition layer over the already modeled 1783 acquisition and 1784 recognition, not a fresh February 1792 territorial addition.

territoryChanges.notes: Recognition/status only; it must not duplicate the 1783 Crimea/Taman/Kuban acquisition polygon when that historical area is materialized.
